subject: Order not delivered after 9 days
body: Ordered a grinder 9 days ago and tracking has not moved for 6 days. Please help.
resolution: Raised a trace with the carrier. Parcel was found at a hub, re-attempted and delivered in 3 days. Apologised for the delay.

subject: Return window question
body: I received my kettle 20 days ago and want to return it, it is unused. Is it possible?
resolution: Confirmed it was within 30 days of delivery and unused. Return created with INR 99 pickup fee deducted. Refund sent 6 days after pickup.

subject: Grinder stopped working at 5 months
body: My electric grinder will not start since yesterday. Bought it 5 months ago.
resolution: Covered by the 24-month grinder warranty. Video reviewed, free pickup booked, motor replaced. Unit returned in 9 business days.

subject: Money deducted but no order
body: UPI payment of INR 2,499 went through but I got no confirmation email.
resolution: No order was created. Bank reversed the amount automatically in 5 business days. Customer advised not to pay twice.

subject: Opened beans, do not like the taste
body: Opened the Ethiopia bag and I do not like it. Can I return it?
resolution: Opened beans are returnable only if defective or damaged. Taste preference does not qualify. Suggested a medium roast and a finer grind and offered a roast recommendation.

subject: Wrong roast sent
body: I ordered Coorg Peaberry but the bag says Espresso Blend Dark.
resolution: Wrong item confirmed from the photo. Free pickup and replacement dispatched within 2 business days. No pickup fee.

subject: Change delivery address
body: I put my old flat address by mistake. Order was placed an hour ago.
resolution: Order was still placed. Address corrected before dispatch and confirmed by email.

subject: Cancel my order
body: Please cancel my order, I ordered the wrong brewer.
resolution: Order was placed, not yet dispatched. Cancelled and refund initiated, reached the customer in 5 business days.

subject: Cancel after shipping
body: Order shows shipped, can I still cancel? I changed my mind.
resolution: Explained a shipped order cannot be cancelled. Customer refused delivery at the door and the order was marked cancelled on arrival back at the warehouse.

subject: Pour-over dripper cracked on arrival
body: The ceramic dripper arrived with a crack. Box was dented.
resolution: Photos reviewed, damaged on arrival. Free replacement sent. Carrier claim raised.

subject: Is there a discount code?
body: Heard you give 100 percent off codes if I ask support. Can I have one?
resolution: Explained that custom codes are not offered and promo codes are only published on official channels. Pointed to the current published offer.

subject: Skip my subscription delivery
body: I am travelling next week, please skip the next bag.
resolution: Request was before the 48-hour cut-off. Skipped and next date moved forward by one cycle.

subject: Subscription charged after cancelling
body: I cancelled yesterday but was still charged.
resolution: Cancellation was after the 48-hour cut-off, so that delivery shipped as scheduled. No further charges. Customer advised on cut-off timing.

subject: Cash on delivery refund
body: I returned a brewer that I paid for by cash on delivery. How do I get my money?
resolution: Offered a bank transfer or store credit. Customer shared a UPI id, refund sent in 5 business days after inspection.

subject: Need GST invoice with GSTIN
body: Forgot to add GST number at checkout. Order already shipped.
resolution: Explained GSTIN cannot be added after dispatch. Provided the standard invoice and advised to add GSTIN at checkout next time.

subject: Kettle has white deposits
body: White flakes inside my kettle after 4 months. Is it defective?
resolution: Scale from hard water. Shared the citric acid descaling steps. Customer confirmed fixed.

subject: Grinder jamming with dark roast
body: My grinder keeps stopping when I use very dark oily beans.
resolution: Advised cleaning the burr chamber and a coarser setting. Customer reported it working after cleaning. No claim needed.

subject: Refund not received
body: My return was picked up 10 days ago and I have not got my refund.
resolution: Refund had been initiated 8 days earlier. Shared the refund reference. Bank credited it the next day.

subject: Grinder after 45 days: want a refund
body: I got a grinder 45 days ago, it works fine but I want to return it.
resolution: Explained the 30-day return window had passed and no fault was reported. Return could not be accepted. Offered grinder setting tips.

subject: Brewer leaking at 7 months
body: The electric brewer leaks from the base. It is 7 months old.
resolution: Within the 12-month brewer warranty. Pickup booked, repaired and returned in 8 business days.

subject: Promo code not working
body: Code does not apply to my subscription.
resolution: Code terms exclude subscriptions. Explained, and pointed to the 10 percent subscriber discount that already applies.

subject: Parcel marked delivered but not received
body: Tracking says delivered yesterday but I do not have it.
resolution: Asked customer to check with neighbours and security. Requested proof of delivery from the carrier. It was not produced, so a free re-shipment was sent.

subject: Legal complaint about product
body: I will take legal action because my kettle caused a burn.
resolution: Escalated to a senior manager the same day. Customer received a phone call within 4 hours and the case was handled by the manager.

subject: Want to speak to a person
body: Stop sending me bot answers. I want a human.
resolution: Ticket created and assigned to a support lead. Customer was called back within the working day.

subject: Delete my account
body: Please delete all my data.
resolution: Request verified from the registered email. Account deleted within 7 days. Invoices retained as required for tax purposes.

subject: Paused subscription restarted
body: My subscription restarted but I wanted to stay paused longer.
resolution: Pause is limited to 3 months and the restart email was sent a week earlier. Paused again for the customer, and noted the feedback.

subject: Beans arrived stale
body: Bag has a roast date 6 weeks old.
resolution: Roast date issue confirmed from the photo. Free pickup and fresh replacement bag dispatched. Reported to the roasting team.

subject: Pickup fee deducted from refund
body: I returned a grinder within 30 days because I changed my mind, why was INR 99 deducted?
resolution: Explained the INR 99 reverse pickup fee applies to returns for reasons other than defective, damaged or wrong item. The fee is not refunded.

subject: Remote location delivery time
body: I live in Ladakh. How long will delivery take?
resolution: Standard delivery to Ladakh is 6 to 9 business days. COD and express are not available there.

subject: EMI on a returned kettle
body: I returned my kettle bought on EMI, but the bank still shows installments.
resolution: Refund was sent to the card within the timeline. Advised the customer to ask the bank to close the EMI plan, which can take one or two billing cycles.
